decisions.quote: We replicate one of the first studies on the dynamics of diversification, Chang (1996). Our sample of public and private firms from 1992 to 2001 yields findings similar to the earlier research.
decisions.reason: In the supplied abstract, the authors state an explicit overall affirmative verdict on the replication of Chang (1996): their 1992–2001 sample 'yields findings similar to the earlier research' (Research summary) and after summarizing Chang's (1996) findings for large public manufacturing firms in the 1980s, they conclude that '[o]ur data show that these patterns continued in the 1990s' (Managerial summary). The private-firm differences are presented as an extension to a population not in Chang's public-firm study rather than a failure to replicate Chang (1996), and the shipped full-text quote is not present in the supplied source. Under Rule 1, this explicit overall verdict in the supplied source establishes a 'successful' outcome.
